title: SPEAK INTO THE FIRST SUNDAY OF FEBRUARY BEFORE THE ENEMY DOES
text: Good morning church. The spirit of the Lord is heavy in this place. Before we go any further, I want you to understand something. God has spoken a word and this word is not for you alone. When you leave this building today, carry this message. Share it, send it, text it, call somebody. Because the enemy is strategizing and the Lord is saying to his people, speak fast, speak loud, speak with authority. This is not a suggestion. This is a command from heaven. Listen to me. February is not just another month. The first Sunday of February carries weight in the spirit realm. The enemy knows this. That is why he begins his operations before the month even arrives. He is trying to set his agenda to plant his seeds of confusion to mark calendars in the demonic realm. But we serve a God who is not surprised. We serve a God who moves faster than the enemy's strategy. We serve a God who even now is positioning his people to speak into this season with the authority of Christ. I want you to turn with me to Proverbs 23:7. The Bible says, "As a man thinkketh in his heart, so is he." Do you understand what this verse is saying? [music] It is saying that the power of what you speak, the power of what you decree [music] shapes the reality of what you become. If you allow the enemy to speak [music] into your February, into your year, into your family, into your business, then that becomes your reality. But if you speak first, if you decree the word of the Lord, if you align your words with the will of God, then you become a co-creator with the Almighty. Your words become seeds planted in the soil of the supernatural realm. This is the revelation that has been burning in my spirit. The Lord showed me in the early hours of this morning that there are people listening to this message right now who have been assigned assignments against this season. There are altars in the demonic realm that have been raised. There are meetings that have already taken place in the underground where they are plotting against your promotion, against your marriage, against your healing. But the spirit of God is saying, "Not on our watch. Not in this generation. Not while the blood of Jesus still speaks." Let me establish something from scripture. Turn to Isaiah 45:11. Listen to what the Lord is saying. Thus sayeth the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, and his maker, ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands, command ye me. Do you see what God is doing here? He's giving [music] you permission. He's giving you authority. He's saying, "Ask me." He's saying, "Command me." He's saying [music] speak it into existence. This is not arrogance. This is not presumption. This is the order of the kingdom. When you pray, when you decree, when you speak the word of the Lord with faith, you are commanding the resources of heaven to come into alignment with your situation. The enemy does not want you to understand this principle. That is why he tries to keep you silent, to keep you paralyzed, to keep you waiting for someone else to pray for you, waiting for someone else to speak on your behalf. But February comes and the Lord is raising up voices. The Lord is raising up prophets. The Lord is raising up intercessors who will speak with the authority of heaven. There are dimensions to this that I need to explain to you. When we say speak into the first Sunday of February, we are not just talking about positive affirmations. We are not just talking about faith and confidence. We are talking about operating in a spiritual authority that has been purchased for us by the blood of Jesus. We are talking about understanding that in the kingdom of God, words [music] carry creative power. Genesis chapter 1 shows us this. When God spoke, creation came into being. He did not ask for permission. He did not doubt. [music] He spoke and it was done. And the scripture tells us in Romans 12:2 that we are to be transformed by the renewing of our minds that we might prove what is that good and acceptable and perfect will of God. This means that as your mind is transformed by the word of God, as your words begin to align with the will of God, you become a vehicle through which the will of God is executed in the earth. Now listen carefully. The enemy knows this principle also. That is why he is speaking. That is why he's whispering. That is why he's creating circumstances and situations designed to provoke you into speaking his language, his reality, his defeat. He wants you [music] to say, "This year will be hard." He wants you to say, "I don't see how God will do it." He wants you to say, "The economy is bad. The times are tough." And when you say these things, you are cooperating with his agenda. You are giving your voice, your authority to his plan against your life. But February is different. [music] February comes with a charge from heaven. Listen to what the spirit of God is speaking. [music] The first Sunday of February is marked in heaven as a day of decree, [music] a day of declaration, a day when the people of God rise up and speak life into their situations, [music] speak power into their destinies, speak deliverance into their families. I need you to understand something about spiritual authority. Turn with me to Matthew chapter 16 [music] 18 and 19. Jesus is speaking to Peter and he says, "And I say also unto thee that thou art Peter and upon this rock I will build my church and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it. And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven. And whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven. And whatsoever thou shalt lose on earth shall be loosed in heaven. Do you see what Jesus is giving to his church? He's giving keys. Keys represent authority and access. He's saying that what you bind on earth, heaven backs up. What you lose on earth, heaven backs up. This means that when you stand up in the first Sunday of February and you decree and declare the will of God, the armies of heaven move, angels that have been standing at attention waiting for the word from God's people, they move. Demons that have been operating freely in darkness, they tremble. This is not fantasy. This is scripture. This is the order of the kingdom. Now, there is something else that the spirit has laid on my heart to tell you. The enemy is not just coming after your finances. He's not just coming after your family. He's not just coming after your health. The enemy is coming after the foundation of your faith. [music] He's trying to create in you a consciousness of defeat, a mentality that God does not care. A belief system that says, "I am powerless." But the Lord is saying, "No, in this season you will arise. In this season, you will speak. In this season, you will declare the word of the Lord with boldness. And as you do, everything that the enemy has planted against you will be uprooted. Every altar that has been raised against you will be dismantled. Every assignment will be aborted. [music] I am sensing something in the spirit right now. There is someone listening to this message and the Lord is revealing to you that there is a covenant that was made over your family that you did not authorize. Your grandmother's grandmother in a moment of desperation made a vow. Your father in a time of frustration spoke a curse and that curse has been operating in your family for generations. But the Lord is saying not anymore. Not on your watch. The power of the blood of Jesus breaks every covenant that was not made in his name. The authority of the resurrection breaks every curse that was established in darkness. Let me tell you what is happening in the spirit realm right now. At this moment as we gather on this Sunday morning, there are meetings taking place. I am not speaking metaphorically. There are actual convocations happening in the darkness [music] where they are trying to update their strategies, trying to figure out how to continue their operations against the people of God. Some of you, your names have been called in those meetings. Some of you, your situations have been discussed. They are trying to determine how to escalate the pressure in February. But while they are gathering, the spirit of God is raising up a people who know their authority. A people who know their position in Christ, a people who understand that they have been seated with Christ in heavenly places far above all principalities and powers. Ephesians 2:es 8-10. The scripture says, "For by grace are ye saved through faith, and that not of yourselves. It is the gift of God, not of works, lest any man should boast. For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God had before ordained that we should walk in them. Do you understand what this is saying? You were created in Christ Jesus for a purpose. God has already prepared good works for you to walk in. This is not something you need to earn. This is not something you need to prove. You were created for this. February is not a month where things happen to you. February is a month where you step into what was already prepared for you. The Lord is speaking to somebody right now. Your season has come. The things that you have been praying for, the things you have been believing God for, the shifts you have been waiting to see, they are not late. They are not slow. They are coming. But they are coming in response to your faith, [music] in response to your authority, in response to your willingness to speak life into your situation. I want to speak to something that is very real in the spirit. There is witchcraft. There is real demonic activity. There are people who have been assigned by the kingdom of darkness to target certain individuals. I am not being sensational. I am being honest. The word of God tells us in 1 Peter 5:8, "Be sober, be vigilant, because your adversary, the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about seeking whom he may devour." The enemy is not resting. The enemy is not on vacation. The enemy is actively seeking those he can devour. But the word of God also says that greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world. This means that the power that lives in you through the Holy Spirit [music] is greater than the power of all demonic forces combined. When you speak, when [music] you decree, when you declare the word of the Lord, you are operating in a power that has no equal in all the universe. Now, I want to shift our focus to prayer. I want us to enter into a season of warfare, a season of declaration, a season where we take authority over the first Sunday of February and every day that follows. But before we do that, I need to establish something in your spirit. The reason why the enemy fights so hard against your voice, against your declarations, against your authority in prayer is because he knows that prayer works. He knows that the word of God coming out of the mouth of a believer who understands their authority is unstoppable. That is why he has tried to silence you, to discourage you, to make you feel like your prayers don't matter, like your faith is too small, like God does not hear you. But the scripture in 1 John 5:es 14 and 15 says, [music] "And this is the confidence that we have in him that if we ask anything according to his will, [music] he heareth us. And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him. Listen to this carefully. If [music] you ask according to God's will, he hears you. And when he hears you, you have already received what you asked for. This means that your prayer is not something that has to travel through space and time hoping that God will listen. [music] Your prayer when it is in alignment with God's will is immediately received in heaven. It is immediately acted upon. It is immediately enforced [music] by the armies of God. So when we pray today, we are not hoping, we are not begging, [music] we are not trying to convince God to help us. We are accessing what has already been provided. We are taking what has already been purchased. We are enforcing in the earth what has already been decreed in heaven. [music] Let me pray with authority now. Father God, in the name of Jesus Christ in the power of his resurrection, in the authority that he has given to his church, I [music] stand in this place and I speak into the first Sunday of February and every day that follows, I [music] bind every assignment of the enemy against the people of God. I bind every demonic operation that has been set in motion. I bind every curse, every hex, every spell that has been released against this generation by the power of the blood of Jesus. I cancel every negative decree that was spoken over families. I cancel every false prophecy that the enemy has declared. I cancel every assignment that was given in the meetings of darkness. I cancel every covenant that was made outside of the will of God. Father, I ask that you would release your waring angels. Release the hosts of heaven. Release Michael the archangel with the armies of God. Let them go forth and dismantle every altar that has been raised in darkness. Let them go forth and arrest every demonic assignment. Let them go forth and protect every child of God who is listening to this message. I speak to the destinies of the people of God. I declare that your season has come. I declare that February is not a month of struggle but a month of breakthrough. I declare that every barrier that the enemy has tried to erect will crumble before the word of the Lord. I declare that every closed [music] door will open. Every delayed blessing will manifest. Every stolen thing will be recovered by the power of the Holy Ghost. I declare that marriages will be restored. I declare that families will be healed. I declare that the womb will be opened. I declare that the barren will conceive and give birth to their promises. I declare that the sick will be healed. I declare that the broken will be made whole. I declare that the lost will be found. I speak to every spirit of poverty that has tried to dominate families. [music] I bind you. I command you to lose the people of God. I command every financial gate to open. I command every blessing that was stolen to be returned sevenfold. I command the anointing of increase to rest upon the people of God. There is someone listening right now. The spirit of the Lord is saying to you, your winter is over. Your season of testing is complete. The trial that you have been in, the fire that you have been walking through, it has perfected your faith. Now I am bringing you into your season of manifestation. I also sense in the spirit that there is a woman whose womb has been closed. The Lord is saying your womb is opening. The surgery is not necessary. The report of the doctor is not the final word. I open your womb in the name of Jesus. I break the curse of barness. I lose the anointing of motherhood upon you. You will carry. You will conceive. You will give birth to your destiny. There is a man whose marriage is hanging by a thread. You have been thinking about walking away. You have been considering divorce. But the spirit of God is saying, "Wait. I am not finished with this union. I am going to restore what the enemy has tried to destroy. I am going to bring healing where there is hurt. I am going to bring understanding where there is confusion. Your marriage will become a testimony. Your marriage will become a beacon of light to those around you. Someone is listening and you are under severe financial pressure. The bills are mounting. The income is decreasing. [music] The future looks dark. But the Lord is saying your provision is coming. Your prosperity is coming. I have prepared something for you that you do not even know about yet. There is a connection that will be made. [music] There is an opportunity that will present itself. There is a blessing that is waiting for you. I want to go deeper into the spirit now. There are spiritual blockages that need to be broken. There are covenants that need to be severed. There are assignments that need to be arrested. Turn with me to Deuteronomy chapter 28 15-19. The scripture says, "But it shall come to pass, if thou will not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day, that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee. Coset shalt thou be in the city, and coret shalt thou be in the field. Coset shall be thy basket and thy stall. cursed shall be the fruit of thy body and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kind and the flocks of thy sheep. Now, [music] this is a scripture that many people misunderstand. They read this and they think it is a threat from God. But listen to me. This is [music] actually God showing us something very important. God is saying that disobedience brings causes. But more importantly, God is showing us that causes are real. Causes are not just psychological. Causes are not just in your mind. Causes are spiritual realities that have actual consequences. Now, some of you listening to this message, your family has been under a curse for generations. Your great-grandfather made an agreement with darkness. Your grandmother worshiped at an altar that was not the altar of God. Your father in a moment of anger spoke words that created a spiritual opening. [music] And from that opening, a course has been operating. But listen to what comes next in [music] Deuteronomy chapter 28 verse 1 and 2. And it shall come to pass if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth. [music] and all these blessings shall come on thee and overtake thee if thou shalt hearken unto the [music] voice of the Lord thy God. Do you see the reversal? If you will hearken unto the Lord, if you will obey, if you will align yourself with God, [music] then the blessings will overtake you. The same principle works in reverse. The cost can become a [music] blessing, the darkness can become light, the captivity can become freedom. And this is what is happening as we speak into February. We are breaking the power of every cause. We are severing every evil covenant. We are cancelling every negative decree. [music] And in their place, we are releasing the blessing of God. I want to pray now for the breaking of generational causes. Father God, I come before you in the name of Jesus Christ. I come with the authority that was purchased by his blood. I come on behalf of every person listening to this message who carries in their bloodline the weight of generational curses. I break the power of every curse spoken over the fathers that has extended to the children. I break the power of every covenant made in darkness. I break the power of every agreement with the enemy. I break the power of every altar that was raised outside of your will. By the blood of Jesus, I sever the connection between this generation and the sins of the fathers. By the power of the resurrection, I declare that you are free. You are no longer bound by what your ancestors did. You are no longer subject to the consequences of their disobedience. Father, I ask that you would break the chains. I ask that you would dismantle the spiritual structures that have been built over these families. I ask that you would release these people from bondage. Father, even as I pray, I am decreeing and declaring that the yoke is broken, the burden is removed, the weight is lifted. I speak now to the spirits of infirmity, the spirits of poverty, the spirits of shame, the spirits of rejection that have been operating in families. I bind you. I [music] command you to lose the people of God. I command you to depart. I command you to go to the pit by the power of the Holy Ghost. [music] I declare new beginnings. I declare that the children of God are released from the sins of their fathers. I declare that they are healed from the wounds of their past. I declare that they are stepping into a new anointing, a new blessing, a new season. Father, as we stand in the first Sunday of February, I ask that you would mark this as a turning point. I ask that you would mark this as the day when everything changes. Mark it in heaven. Mark it in the spirit realm. Let the demonic kingdom know that this family is no longer available. Let them know that this person is no longer their assignment. Let them know that the blood of Jesus covers them. I also want to address something that the spirit has laid on my heart. There are marriages that are in trouble. There are husbands and wives who are not speaking. There are families that are fragmented, but the Lord is saying this is the season of restoration. Let me go to 1 Corinthians chapter 7:1. Paul is writing about marriage and he says, "And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord. Let not the wife depart from her husband, but and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband, and let not the husband put away his wife. Notice what Paul is emphasizing. Reconciliation is always the priority. Restoration is always the goal. This is the heart of God. God does not want divorce. God does not want separation. God wants reconciliation. God wants healing. God wants the broken to be made whole. So as we speak into February, we're speaking reconciliation. We're speaking healing. We're speaking wholeness into marriages. [music] I want to pray specifically for marriages. Now I place my hand upon every marriage that is under attack. I bind the spirit of adultery. I bind the spirit of unforgiveness. I bind the spirit of bitterness. I bind every demonic attempt to divide what God has joined together by the power of the Holy Ghost. I release the anointing of love. [music] I release the anointing of understanding. I release the anointing of forgiveness. I speak to husbands and wives. I command the wall of division to crumble. I command the spirit of communication to return. I command hearts to be softened. Father, [music] I ask that you would perform the work of reconciliation. I ask that you would heal the wounds that have been created. I ask that you would restore what has been broken. Father, let marriages become stronger than they have ever been. Let them become testimonies of your power. For those who are single, I speak destiny. I speak wholeness. I speak that God will prepare you for the right covenant at the right time. The counterfeit will pass by. the wrong connection will not stick but the right assignment, the right partner, the right person will recognize you and will be assigned to you. I also want to address the issue of finances. This is something that the enemy uses constantly to create fear, to create stress, to create anxiety. Turn with me to Malachi 3:10. The Lord says, "Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse that there may be food in my house. Test me in this, says the Lord Almighty, and see if I will not throw open the floodgates of heaven and pour out so much blessing [music] that there will not be room enough to store it. Listen to what God is saying. He's inviting you to test him. He's inviting you to give and to see if he will not provide. He's promising open floodgates. He's promising abundance. He's promising overflow. But here is what I want you to understand. The enemy does not want you to give. The enemy does not want you to sow. The enemy wants you to hold on to what you have, to be fearful, to be stingy because the enemy knows that giving activates the blessing. [music] Giving activates the supernatural supply of God. So in this season of February, I am calling forth the spirit of generosity. I am calling forth the willingness to sow. [music] I am calling forth the faith to believe that God will multiply what you planned. [music] Let me pray for the opening of financial gates. Father, I come before you on behalf of every person who has been struggling financially. I come on behalf of those who have been trying to make ends meet. [music] I come on behalf of those who have been worrying about how they will pay the bills, how they will take care of their families, how they [music] will provide. Father, I break the spirit of poverty. I break the assignment of lack. I [music] break the curse of scarcity that the enemy has tried to place by the blood of Jesus. I declare that poverty has no legal right to [music] operate in the lives of the redeemed. I open the gates of prosperity. I open the floodgates of blessing. I release the anointing of multiplication. Father, I ask that you would cause increase to come upon the people of God. I ask that you would open doors of opportunity. I ask that you would provide in ways that are beyond their understanding. Father, there are people listening who do not even know how they will survive the next month. But the spirit of God is saying, "I will make a way. I will provide. I will sustain you. Your trust in me will not be disappointed." I also speak to the entrepreneurs, the business owners, those who are trying to grow their enterprises. I open doors that no man can shut. I break every barrier to your success. I speak favor. I speak goodwill. I speak that your business will prosper and that you will become a blessing to many. There is someone listening right now. The Lord is showing me that you have been thinking about a business idea. You have been holding back because you are afraid. You are afraid of failure. You are afraid of not having enough capital. You afraid of what people will think. But the spirit of God is saying launch it. Move forward. I will provide the resources. I will open the doors. Your enterprise will succeed. Let me now address the issue of health and healing. This is an area where many people are struggling. I want to turn to 3R John verse two. The Apostle John writes, "Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health even as thy soul prosperth." Notice what John is saying. Healing is not some distant hope. Healing is not something that only happens in heaven. Healing is the will of God for your life right now. Healing is a priority for God. God wants you to be in health. God wants your body to function properly. God wants you to be strong and whole. There is warfare happening over the bodies of God's people. [music] There are assignments against your health. There are diseases that the enemy is trying to plant. There are infirmities that have been assigned. [music] But the scripture is clear. By the stripes of Jesus, we are healed. This is not a future promise. This is a present reality. Let me pray for healing and wholeness. Father, I stand in this place and I speak healing into the bodies of the people of God. I bind every spirit of infirmity. I [music] bind every demonic assignment against health. I bind every disease that the enemy has tried to plant. By the stripes of Jesus Christ, [music] by his blood, by his resurrection power, I speak healing into every body part that is diseased, I speak wholeness into every broken system. I speak restoration into every area of sickness. Father, there is someone listening who has been diagnosed with a terminal illness. The doctors have given you a death sentence, but the spirit of God is saying, "I have other plans. I have purposes for your life that extend beyond this sickness. I am raising you up. I am healing you. You will live and not die. You will declare the works of the Lord. There is someone with cancer. The cancer is shrinking right now. Even as we speak, the cells are being destroyed. The tumor is being dissolved. The healing is taking place in your body. There is someone with diabetes. I break the power of this disease. I command your pancreas to function properly. I command your blood sugar to regulate. I command normaly to return to your body. There is someone who has been struggling with depression, with anxiety, with mental anguish. I speak peace to your mind. I speak clarity to your thoughts. I speak healing to your emotions. The torment will cease. The darkness will lift. The light will break through. Father, I also speak to those who are battling addiction, whether it is alcohol, drugs, pornography, or any other substance that has enslaved them. I break the power of addiction. I break the chains. I lose the power of the Holy Ghost to deliver. I command the cravings to cease. I command the desire to be removed. I declare that you are free. You are clean. You are whole. [music] There is someone listening and you have had a smoking habit for many years. You have tried to quit and you have failed. But in this moment as the word of God is being spoken, something is shifting in the spirit. The power of the Holy Ghost is breaking the addiction by tomorrow you will not want it anymore. The bondage is broken. I now want to shift and address something that is very serious. There is witchcraft. There are people who have been assigned by witches and wizards to target the people of God. Listen to me. I am not being sensational. [music] I am not being fearful. I am stating the truth of scripture. The book of Exodus 22:18 says, "Thou shalt not suffer a witch to leave." This is in the Old Testament law. And while we do not execute anyone under the new covenant, [music] we do recognize that witchcraft is real and it must be addressed with spiritual authority. Witchcraft operates through the power of the mind. It operates through curses. It operates through demonic assignments. A witch does not need to touch you. A witch does not need to know you personally. A witch can project witchcraft into your life from a distance targeting your family, your business, your health, your relationships. I have been shown in the spirit that there are witches who have specific assignments against believers. I have been shown covens that meet and make declarations against the people of God. I have been shown altars that are dedicated to the destruction of families. But listen to what the scripture says in 1 John 4:4. It says, "Ye are of God, little [music] children, and have overcome them because greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world. The greater one is in you." This means that your authority is greater than the power of witchcraft. This means that the anointing on your life is stronger [music] than any curse that can be spoken. This means that you have the power to break the assignments. Let me pray for the breaking of witchcraft assignments. Father God, in the name of Jesus Christ, [music] I come against every witch and every warlock that has been assigned to the people of God. I come against every covenant that is meeting [music] in darkness. I come against every altar that has been raised to the destruction [music] of families by the blood of Jesus. I break every curse that has been spoken. I break every assignment that has been given. I [music] break every spell that has been cast. Every arrow that has been shot at the people of God, I break it. Every evil eye that has been directed, I shut it down. Father, I bind every demonic familiar spirit that has been assigned to operate in families. I bind every spirit of control. I bind every spirit of manipulation. I bind every spirit that is trying to fragment families, that is trying to sow discord, that is trying to create division. By the authority of Jesus Christ, I command every witchcraft assignment to be arrested. I command every demonic operation to cease. I command every dark meeting to be disrupted. I command that the plans of darkness will not stand. Father, I ask that you would release guardian angels, release the hosts of heaven, release the waring angels. Let them go forth and protect the people of God. Let them go forth and dismantle the works of darkness. Let them go forth and arrest every evil assignment. I speak now with the authority of Christ, every witchcraft altar that was raised to attack the people of God. I decree that you catch fire. I decree that you bend to ashes. I decree that your power is broken. I decree that your effectiveness is destroyed. Let the fire of God fall upon every demonic altar. There is someone listening and you have felt the weight of witchcraft on your life. You have experienced unexplainable sicknesses. You have seen patterns of misfortune. You have felt blocked in every direction. But the spirit of God is saying the siege is over. The blockade is broken. The witchcraft assignment is canceled. You are free. You are released. You are stepping into a new season of peace and blessing. I also want to address the issue of stolen virtue and stolen time. This is something that many people do not understand. Turn with me to Isaiah 49 24 and 25. The scripture says, "Shall the prey be taken from the mighty or the lawful captive delivered?" But thus sayeth the Lord, even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered. For I will contend with him that contended with thee, and I will save thy children. What is Isaiah saying? He's saying that there are people whose time has been stolen. Their years have been taken. Their opportunities have been lost. But God is saying that he will recover what was taken. He will deliver what was held captive. Think about this. How many years has the enemy stolen from you? How many opportunities have you missed? How many blessings have been delayed? How much time has been wasted in confusion, in struggle, in things that were not part of God's plan. But the Lord is saying, "I am restoring. I am recovering. I am giving back the years that the locust has eaten. I am giving back the time that was stolen." Let me pray for the restoration of stolen time and virtue. Father, I come before you on behalf of every person whose time has been stolen by the enemy. I come on behalf of those whose years have been wasted in struggle and confusion. I come on behalf of those whose opportunities have been delayed and lost. Father, I ask that you would restore the years. I ask that you would compress time. I ask that you would give back what was stolen in one year. Let there be the progress of 10. In one season, let there be the breakthrough of many years. Father, I also speak to those whose virtue has been stolen. Your innocence was taken. Your purity was violated. Your dignity was assaulted. But the spirit of God is saying, "I am restoring. I am healing. I am making you whole. The shame is removed. The guilt [music] is gone. The past is redeemed. You are stepping into newness." For those who have lost years to sickness, the Lord is saying, "I will restore your health and your vigor. You will function as though you are young again."
